notes.title: Not dead!
notes.notes:
Just a quick note to reassure you that the project isn't dead or abandoned. The initial thrust of development was to get the engine up and working, and all the tools necessary to place gates, resources, along with the AI ships, spawns and all the handling models. That's 95% complete now, meaning the vast majority of the rest of the work falls to the designer!

Sadly, he's had a bit of a health upset, and isn't able to work on the game currently. We're both itching to continue work on the game, and any code issues I can absolutely work on. 

As ever, please please please feel free to give feedback. We're always available on Discord, and you're all 100% welcome to come and discuss the things you love or hate about the game!

https://discord.gg/VBs69PK6Zx

notes.title: Second Level available for testing and feedback
notes.notes:
The Staging Branch has been updated with the latest build of the second level. 

This level's design takes a very different approach to the first one. The first level is very much a 360 degree play space, with lots of zig-zagging paths to be taken by the 2d player. As accessibility is very important, one of the design requirements for the second level is that it takes place entirely in [i]front[/i] of the VR player. As well as this, the path taken by the 2d player is linear; they start on the left hand side, move through to the right, before returning to the left.

Our local playtesting has shown this level, surprisingly, to be very hard for the VR player to win. As part of trying to balance that a little, we've scaled up the police speeds. As ever - we do need feedback. Does this level work? Are the police too easy? Are there too many places for the 2d player to hide in?

notes.title: 2024 begins!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!  Whilst we've been terribly quiet, work has been continuing, and we're hopefully not too far from making the second level publicly available. 

We've been trying to have plenty of variety in the levels; some are going to be easier for the 2d player, some for the VR player. The first level has a lot of zig-zagging, multiple routes, and scope for huge subterfuge for the pancake player. 

This next level is very different - the 2d player moves along a fairly linear path  (with plenty of cover and branching-and-collapsing-routes), and it's *much* clearer to the VR player how far through the level the Heister is. At the end, there's many routes to the exit. This level also takes place in a 180 degree arc, meaning a very different VR experience. It's available now in bleeding_edge.

Remember! Your feedback is important! Are any levels too hard? Easy? Confusing? Suggestions for new levels or mechanics? We're always here to listen!

The Action Replay system is also available, and it really works well to get a "Oh what, you went THAT way!" response; this also helps players to evolve strategies to beat each other constantly.

notes.title: 🚀 Astro Heist 2 Week Launchiversary! 🚀
notes.notes:
Dear [b]Astro Heist[/b] Community,

It's hard to believe that it's been two weeks since we embarked on this thrilling journey together. Today, we want to celebrate not just the passage of time but the incredible milestones and achievements we've reached with your invaluable support.

[b]Your Feedback Powers Our Progress[/b]

First and foremost, we want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who has joined us in the early stages of [b]Astro Heist[/b]'s journey. Your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions have been instrumental in shaping the future of the game. We've been hard at work behind the scenes, diligently addressing your comments and actively implementing changes that enhance your gaming experience.

[b]Our Vision for the Future[/b]

As we look ahead, we're excited to share some glimpses of what's on the horizon for [b]Astro Heist[/b]:

[b]New Levels[/b]: We're thrilled to announce that we're actively working on bringing you new levels to explore and conquer. Each one will present its own unique challenges and opportunities for you to master.

[b]Additional Vehicles[/b]: Expect to see an array of new vehicles, each with its own set of abilities and strategic advantages, providing fresh and exciting ways to engage in the action.

[b]Enhanced VR Mechanics[/b]: We're continually refining the VR gameplay experience, making it more immersive, responsive, and enjoyable for our VR players.

[b]More Community Interaction[/b]: We love engaging with our community, and we're committed to more interactive events, live streams, and direct communication to ensure we're hearing your voices loud and clear.

[b]Join Us on This Incredible Journey[/b]

The past two weeks have been a whirlwind, but we're more excited than ever to continue this adventure with you. We invite you to share your thoughts, ideas, and suggestions with us because your input is the lifeblood of [b]Astro Heist[/b]'s development.

As we move forward, we promise to keep pushing the boundaries of what's possible and delivering a unique, engaging, and thrilling gaming experience. Together, we're shaping the future of [b]Astro Heist[/b], here's a sneak peek of a quick lighting test for the next level:

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1127675327368396930/1146147143128727602/image.png[/img]
Thank you for being part of this remarkable journey. Here's to the next chapter!

Stay cosmic, The [b]Astro Heist[/b] Development Team

notes.title: 🚀 Astro Heist Launch Day! 🚀
notes.notes:
🚀 [b]Astro Heist - Now Available on Steam![/b] 🚀

Greetings, space aficionados!

The moment you've all been waiting for has finally arrived. We are thrilled to announce that [b]Astro Heist[/b] is now available for purchase and play on Steam!

Ready for a unique 2-player cosmic duel? Dive into a universe where you get to decide: will you be the cunning PC infiltrator, breaching defenses in pursuit of treasure? Or will you take on the role of a vigilant VR guardian, defending your space outpost objectives from intruders?

🌌 Key Features 🌌

[list]
[*] Frantic PvP Action: Challenge friends locally or harness the power of Remote Play Together.
[*] Innovative PC vs. VR Gameplay: Experience a fresh take on multiplayer, where platform boundaries blur.
[*] Just One Copy Required: Engage with your rival where only one copy of the game is required.
[/list]

We've poured our passion and dedication into crafting [b]Astro Heist[/b], and now we're beyond excited to share this stellar adventure with all of you. We're eagerly awaiting your feedback, strategies, epic space heist tales, and unforgettable moments.

Watch our play through via the link below showing a single session of how the game is played, along with commentary from us giving some insights into the development process:

🎮[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GtOzYXPNZZM]Astro Heist - Dev Plays[/url]

🔗[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510540/Astro_Heist/]Click here to embark on your Astro Heist journey![/url]

A massive thank you to our community for your unwavering support and enthusiasm throughout the development process. The universe of [b]Astro Heist[/b] awaits you!

Stay cosmic, The [b]Astro Heist[/b] Development Team
